levelIntro.logic-tutorial: A program is a list of steps. Tap blocks to build one: drive to the house, then drop supplies. Tap Run to go!
levelIntro.logic-l1: Two houses need supplies, and order matters. Plan which one to visit first so your program fits the block limit.
levelIntro.logic-l2: Same kind of trip, fewer blocks allowed. The Repeat block does the steps inside it several times. Use it to say it shorter.
levelIntro.logic-l3: One of two roads floods, and which one changes every run. Use “If road ahead is flooded” and “Otherwise” to pick the dry road.
levelIntro.logic-l4: Bonus! This program has a bug (a mistake in the steps). Run it, watch where the truck goes wrong, then swap the bad block.
levelIntro.logic-l5: Bonus! Each house needs water, food or a medical kit. “Ask the AI” uses the model you trained earlier to pick the right one.

levelHint.logic-tutorial: Count the squares to each corner. Turn where the road turns, then Drop supplies at the house.
levelHint.logic-l1: Trace both orders with your finger. Pick the one with fewer moves and turns, since each costs a block.
levelHint.logic-l2: Spot the part that repeats. Put it inside Repeat and set how many times.
levelHint.logic-l3: If the road ahead floods, take the side road. Blocks after the If run on both roads.
levelHint.logic-l4: Tap Step to go one block at a time. Watch for the first move that doesn't match the road.
levelHint.logic-l5: Use “Ask the AI, then drop” at every house instead of Drop supplies. It guesses what each house needs.

editor.empty: No blocks yet. Tap a block to add it.
editor.overLimit: Block limit reached. Remove one to add another.
editor.swapPrompt: Now pick a block to swap in.
editor.tutorialHint: Tap a block to add it, then tap Run.

run.success: Delivered! Every house got its supplies.
run.crash: Oops, the truck drove off the road. Check your turns and moves.
run.stuck: The truck drove into flood water. Find a dry road.
run.noHouse: No house here! Drop supplies only when the truck reaches a house.
run.wrongSupply: This house needs something specific. Use “Ask the AI, then drop” here.
run.unfinished: The program ended, but some houses still need supplies.
run.aiWrong: Wrong drops: {n}. Your AI guessed wrong. Better Stage 2 training means fewer mistakes.
run.overLimit: Too many blocks for this puzzle. Look for a shorter way and remove some.
run.nextTry: Every bug you find gets you closer. Tweak and run again!
run.lucky: Lucky! It worked this time, but the other road could flood. Make it work both ways.

answer: Here's a working program, loaded and ready. Tap Run to watch it. Using it costs some points.
timeUp: Time's up! Let's see how your truck did.

result.heading1: Supplies on the move. Good start!
result.heading0: Logic is tricky. Have another go!

learned: You solved {count} puzzles by breaking problems into steps, repeating, deciding and debugging (fixing mistakes). That's programming!
